units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39:8">Gen. R. s. 39</cite> [combine text of ed. with vers. of Ar. and read:] <he>וא״ת שלא ג׳ אברהם ושמח על דבור המקום שאילו ג׳ ושמח למה לא יצא</he> and if you will say, Abraham was not glad and joyful over the command of the Lord (to leave his home), for if he were so, why did he not emigrate (until he was commanded)?

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:11">Cant. R. to IV, 11</cite> the cloud rubbed their clothes <he>ומַגְהִיצָן</he> and polished them; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 23:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXIII</cite> <he>ומְגַהֲצָן</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 850">Yalk. Deut. 850</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 691:1">Yalk. Ps. 691</cite> <he>ענני כביד היו מְגַהֲצִין וכ׳</he>; Pesik. B’shall. p. 92ᵃ <he>מַגְהִיצִים וכ׳</he>; (<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 7:11">Deut. R. s. 7</cite> <he>ומלבנן</he>).
Ib. אין מג׳ אלא באור, (v. אַמְיַינְטוֹן) is cleansed only by fire.—Part. Pu. מְגיּהָץ, pl. מְגוּהָצִין.
<cite ref="Pesachim 109a">Pes. 109ᵃ</cite>. Y. M. Kat. III, 82ᵃ bot.

senses.gloss: to be polished. Cant. R. l. c., a. parallel, passages, v. supra.
